dedupe_keys.name: new caledonia road database bdroute nc 336 231 segments and 296 419 nodes with road traffic counts and heavy load circulation constraints georep

description: The New Caledonia government publishes BDROUTE-NC, a road network database that modernises the roads layer of its topographic database BDTOPO-NC, on the Géorep download platform. Contents: 336,231 road segments and 296,419 nodes with road type, surface, direction of traffic, number of lanes, width, speed limit and its quality, function, acquisition source and date, and validity dates, plus road names; companion layers give 46 automatic traffic count sites with vehicle counts and heavy-vehicle shares, kilometre reference points (BDPR-NC) and restrictions for exceptional loads (clearance and tonnage) on the network. Producer: the government's geomatics service, with the land transport and infrastructure directorate for counts and restrictions. Coverage: the whole of New Caledonia (Grande Terre and islands). Format and access: ArcGIS feature services with query and export, and a file geodatabase download on the Géorep hub; the lineage notes updates in January and March 2026. Licence: Licence Ouverte (Etalab open licence). Caveats: traffic counts are periodic tube counts at a few dozen sites, not continuous; attribute completeness varies for tracks. Simulation uses: routable island road network for accessibility and evacuation, cyclone and flood exposure of the few coastal roads linking communes, and heavy transport routing for mining traffic. Related records: the DIMENC mining cadastre (data-new-caledonia-dimenc-mining-cadastre) on the same platform shows the mines that drive heavy traffic.
